author: C.J. Orakel
title: Looking for artist partner for Kickstarter comedy zine
content:
CALLING ALL ARTISTS! This is not a drill! 

I am looking for an artist to partner with on an EXCITING, new Kickstarter project. I am creating a zine focused solely on comedy, parody, and satire -- in the style of the old Mad Magazine, but with my own fresh spin and style.

Since 2019, Mad Magazine has lost about 88% of its audience, because they went woke and changed its format. Besides that, their formula became really stale and tired. With this zine, my goal is to recapture those readers that Mad turned off or cast aside.

I AIN'T DOIN' NO POLITICS. There is nothing that could be less funny and less boring to me than political humor.

My entire focus of this zine is to just have fun while making the funniest magazine possible.

Who I'm looking to partner with on this project:

1) I'm looking for the the ideal, killer combo: artist / letterer / graphic designer.

2) Willing to partner with me on this Kickstarter project rather than receive a commission. I'd like to work with someone who has actual skin in the game and is therefore passionate about what we're creating.

3) Has some experience with creating their own zines, newsletters, comic books, or comic strips.

4) Loves comedy and has a robust sense of humor.

5) Someone who shares my vision for this zine. Someone who is excited and passionate about it.

6) Must be trustworthy. (Be honest in your response to this.😁)

7) Must be reliable. I want to work with someone who won't quit halfway through the project. I'm looking for someone with drive -- someone who doesn't stop until the project is finished.

8) Must be at least somewhat based. I promise you'll hate me otherwise. 

9) Must be brave. I promise that at some point the online mob will come for us and will try to cancel us. (You can remain as anonymous as you wish and just do the art. If you want, we could just use your pseudonym for your credits.)

If you're interested in partnering with me on this ambitious project, please email a sample of your work to cjorakel@gmail.com. No DMs, please. I hate DMs. If possible, please embed your sample into the body of the message so I won't have to open any potentially infected attachments (that would suck!). BUT, if you really do have to send it as an attachment, then I understand. (See? I'm easy to work with.)

Alright? Cool. Let's rock.

author: Dandrista
title: Seeking 2D anime artist for Jinx and Pokemon themed assets
content:
LONG THREAD ALERT! I am looking for a 2D artist (or artists) specializing in the anime style, with experience drawing Jinx and Pokémon! If you are interested, please drop your VGen link! (DMs will be blocked, unless you have worked with me previously.) #vgen #VgenComm
I want to share more precise details about what I’m looking for, as there were some misunderstandings regarding my request! I’ll break it down to help you better understand what I need:

1st: 2 PFPs (Profile Pictures) – Both featuring Jinx in outfits from *Pokémon Masters EX*; one with Zekrom, and the other with Jolteon.

2nd: Twitch/YouTube Banner – A single, unified banner for both channels, featuring three characters: Luna Snow, Jinx, and Goku.

*Twitch Panels* – Please note: these will be illustrations, and I will resize them myself as needed.

TWP1: A "Domain Expansion" (anime-style) featuring Kratos, Reze, and Link. This will include references to the various platforms where I can be followed.

TWP2: Two versions of Jinx—one wearing a Goku Black-inspired outfit—set against a background themed after Discord.

TWP3: "Dragon Miku" performing the iconic "Miku Beam" during a concert; this will be used to display my "Rules."

TWP4: Asta (in his Devil Union form) performing a slash—reminiscent of Trunks cutting down Mecha Frieza—to be used for an "About Me" section.

*Illustrations* – Here are my ideas for the illustrations, with a special focus on two that will serve as thumbnails for YouTube and Twitch:

AN1: Jinx wearing a Wolverine-inspired outfit, intended for a *Wolverine*-themed series on Twitch and YouTube.

AN2: Jinx peeking from behind a wall at a horde of zombies—including a zombie version of Vi—as a reference to the *Road to Veronica* series. AN3: Jinx wearing epic *Monster Hunter* armor, facing off against a Fatalis—part of a "ROAD TO FATALIS" series.
**The rest are just some wild ideas I came up with, haha.**

AN4: Jinx as a professor in the *Pokémon Z-A* laboratory, accompanied by a Porygon2.

AN5: Jinx wearing Reze’s outfit, set in the café where Reze and Denji meet.

AN6: Jinx wearing the outfit of Merlina (the final boss from *Sonic and the Black Knight*).

AN7: Jinx in her Season 2 outfit, seen from behind while spray-painting graffiti, with two Pokémon (they’ll be small, though I haven’t decided which ones yet).

AN8: Jinx wearing Zelda’s outfit from the *Tears of the Kingdom* (TOTK) flashback sequences.

In total, there will be 8 separate illustrations. If you’ve read all of this, your chances of being chosen are even higher!

If you’ve read this far, feel free to send me a DM saying, "Voy a Jinxearte, culiaaaao" (I’m going to "Jinx" you, you bastard!), along with a link to your VGEN profile.

I’m counting on you all to bring my vision to life! The budget is $120–$150 for the whole project, though it’s open to negotiation. I’ll share some references that Amber put together so you can see what I’m aiming for—thanks!
